title: QCLI-432 confirmatory-check minors: guide and help omit the lone-state carve-out, the T-3 comment overstates, and identity is unasserted at the CLI layer
description:
Four minor findings from QCLI-432's DEC-172 (4ab) confirmatory review (opum-control review seq 7991, head aeab619a1a489b99cbec0eb000eee5a0d038bb27), none blocking, filed together as one follow-up:

(1)+(2) The task-creation guide (src/application/agents/guides.ts, refs-aware section) and the `task list --across-refs` help (src/application/command-help.ts) describe `identity` without stating the lone-state carve-out: the code returns `task` for ANY group with fewer than two states regardless of createdAt (src/application/refs/across-refs.ts). Read literally, a one-state group with no createdAt matches the `unresolved` clause -- the opposite of the code and of the lone-state test. Both surfaces name only the pair case.

(3) The comment on the T-3 assertion (test/qcli417-across-refs.test.ts) says 'a lone state has nothing to collide with, so it is one task whatever its record carries', but T-3 is created with `quest task create` and so carries a createdAt; removing the guard leaves T-3 green. The lone-no-createdAt property is pinned by the T-9 test, not the assertion this comment annotates.

(4) `identity` is asserted only through the service view(); no test reads it back through the CLI JSON envelope of `task list --across-refs`. AC1 is about what the command reports, and the command layer is unpinned for this field.

Filed by the quest-cli worker at team-lead instruction; UNSTAMPED.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The task-creation guide and the `task list --across-refs` help both state that a lone state (a group of fewer than two states) is always `task`, so a literal reading does not misclassify a lone record with no createdAt as `unresolved`

The comment on the T-3 assertion in test/qcli417-across-refs.test.ts is scoped to what that assertion demonstrates, with the lone-no-createdAt property attributed to the T-9 test that actually pins it
A test asserts `identity` through the CLI JSON envelope of `task list --across-refs`, not only through the service view()
